description: This file defines the CustomersController class, which manages REST endpoints related to customer entities, such as listing, creating, and deleting customers.

classes.name: CustomersController
classes.description: REST controller managing customer-related API endpoints, utilizing Spring Boot annotations for request mapping and API documentation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all customers.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new customer using provided data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer identified by ID.
